findings.path: openspec/changes/afk-live-financial-execution/specs/afk-live-accounting/spec.md#Closed existing accounting fields and bounded successor semantics; records.py::_remaining_from_current
findings.finding: The source contract postpones the MC02 projection disposition's inherited rows/counters and exact active-grant semantics, but also requires a positive real producer/CLI fixture. Existing _remaining_from_current computes master_used = planning + overhead + charges + reserved + external and package_used = planning + overhead + charges, requires package to match the campaign owner, and uses worker_dispatches and the selected successor envelope. The retained master is MC01. The specification does not yet define the machine-checked disposition reference, ownership mapping or counter formulas that determine a valid MC02 projection. A prose assertion that an exact disposition exists, an unconditional unresolved result, or an author-selected shape-valid MC02 example cannot independently establish that positive producer behavior.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add a bounded parameterized projection contract in the existing admission/resource record family. Fix its contained path/digest discovery and the digest/scope checked by the two disposition receipts; identify master generation/hash, source owner MC01, target owner MC02 and active amendment/envelope. Define exhaustive, nonduplicating historical-row attribution between charges/externalPackageCharges, preserved reservation treatment, planning/overhead attribution, inherited selected-package and aggregate dispatch counters/ceilings, and the formula for new-grant reserved/charged remainder without borrowing closed credit. Unknown or unmapped applicable rows/counters must give resource-package-projection-unresolved before any debit. Provide one small normative master+disposition+grant example with independently stated projected totals/counters and one debit's exact effect, plus omitted-row/wrong-owner/duplicate/stale-disposition variants. Exact live amounts, actual vote receipts and live adoption may remain pending. Field names may use a narrow nested extension to existing resources/admission evidence; no new registry/service or broad historical survey is needed.
findings.expectedOutcome: Once the parameterized contract fixes these outcomes, real producer -> current projection -> prepaid records/runner -> store reservation -> master claim -> existing execute can have a positive fixture and falsified controls. Missing actual live evidence must still reject independently. This blocker does not require resolving hypothetical host-global historical costs.
